card.desc: A button, a toggle, a selection. The smallest possible confirmation.
card.prompt: a single short soft plastic button click, close microphone, dry, no reverb
card.negative: music, speech, reverb, echo, repeating, mechanical motor
card.note: Wants to be SHORT and dry - anything with a tail reads as a mechanical switch rather than a UI event.

evidence.method: audio_sweep: rendered + measured (ffmpeg ebur128/silencedetect, librosa flatness)
evidence.note: renders and is not broken [seconds=2.04, lufs=-7.9, true_peak=1.4, silent_fraction=0.36, channels=2]
